from BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbe WHERE 1=1

SELECT a.PARAM_CODE as id, /**参数代码**/ a.PARAM_NAME as text /**参数名称**/ FROM (SELECT vbb.BOOKSET_ID,bbe.PARAM_CODE,bbe.PARAM_VALUE,bbe.PARAM_NAME,bbe.REMARK FROM BOK_BOOKSET vbb LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbe ON vbb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = bbe.BOOKSET_ID WHERE vbb.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BOK_BOOKSET_EXT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}) b ON a.PARAM_CODE = b.PARAM_CODE WHERE b.BOOKSET_ID IS NOT NULL
AND (a.PARAM_CODE like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR a.PARAM_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))

SELECT a.* FROM (SELECT vbb.BOOKSET_ID,bbe.PARAM_CODE,bbe.PARAM_VALUE,bbe.PARAM_NAME,bbe.REMARK FROM BOK_BOOKSET vbb LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbe ON vbb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = bbe.BOOKSET_ID WHERE vbb.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BOK_BOOKSET_EXT WHERE BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}) b ON a.PARAM_CODE = b.PARAM_CODE WHERE b.BOOKSET_ID IS NULL
